patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Freshteam and Breezy HR share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Freshteam and Breezy HR share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Freshteam only if your buying job matches “Freshworks HRMS/ATS — sunset announced ~Mar 2026; onboarded for affiliate inventory comple” rather than Breezy HR's shape. Choose Breezy HR only if your buying job matches “Mid-market ATS with free Bootstrap, paid Startup/Growth/Business pools, career site, and i” rather than Freshteam's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshteam leans core-hris; Breezy HR leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Freshteam and Breezy HR share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Freshteam is Freshworks HRMS/ATS — sunset announced ~Mar 2026; onboarded for affiliate inventory completeness only.; Breezy HR is Mid-market ATS with free Bootstrap, paid Startup/Growth/Business pools, career site, and interview workflows — Growth from $273/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Freshteam (small-business, mid-market) vs Breezy HR (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshteam-leaning core-hris vs Breezy HR-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Freshteam — Freshworks sunset — renewals stopped ~Mar 2026; Breezy HR — Free Bootstrap limits to one active pool/position — not enough for multi-role hiring volume.

Limitations — Freshteam: Freshworks sunset — renewals stopped ~Mar 2026; Do not recommend for new buyers; Breezy HR: Free Bootstrap limits to one active pool/position — not enough for multi-role hiring volume; Breezy Intelligence AI is credit-based add-on packaging, not unlimited included AI.

Poor-fit cases: Freshteam is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Freshworks sunset — renewals stopped ~Mar 2026 · Breezy HR is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Bootstrap limits to one active pool/position — not enough for multi-role hiring volume · Avoid Freshteam if you actually need Breezy HR's motion (Mid-market ATS with free Bootstrap, paid Startup/Growth/Business pools, career s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
